title: Project Scoped Fine Tuning Manifest Schema
description: Privacy-safe export manifest for project-scoped fine-tuning data. Raw content is omitted by default and replaced with hashes and stable references.

privacy_classification.description: Payload-level privacy classification for this response. 'manifest_safe' means hashes/refs only; 'raw_content' means materialized content is included by explicit request and policy allows transmission.

source_privacy_protected.description: Backward-compatible alias for privacy_mode emitted by the backend export manifest.

job_id.description: Recorded export-job identifier for this manifest generation. Null when recording the export job failed: job recording is best effort, so the manifest is still delivered. Delivery itself requires the export audit record; an export whose audit record cannot be written is refused with a 500 and is never delivered.

truncated.description: True when more rows matched the query than the requested limit, so this page was cut at the limit.

empty_reason.description: Null when records is non-empty; otherwise the closed reason no record was produced.

configuration_run_id.x-deprecated: Use trial_id instead. configuration_run_id is a backward-compatible alias maintained while the backend migrates to the trial_id naming convention.

metadata.description: Scalar metadata for local materialization and export context. Non-numeric measure attributes are emitted here with the 'measure_metadata_' prefix.
